Thanks. My window manager is dwm-6.0.
Confirming this issue with the same code posted above, and on dwm-6.0 and Intel graphics of some description.
problem also in dwm-6.1 . SFML 2.2 works
Same issue under dwm, smells like this similiar issue in sdl with bad assumptions about windowmanager behaviour: https://bugzilla.libsdl.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2997

I can confirm this bug is present in the latest release on Arch Linux with dwm. Observed with all combinations of the following relevant installations: official Arch sfml package (2.3.2-3), AUR 'sfml-git' package (2.3.2.r38.g1217699-1), dwm 6.0-1, dwm (6.1-2), and xorg-server (1.18.0-3).

The problem can be observed with the SFML examples provided in /usr/share/SFML/examples/ . The X11 example runs fine, but the OpenGL example dies immediately after the window is created:

```
[hal@machine examples]$ ./X11/X11 
[hal@machine examples]$ ./opengl/opengl 
X Error of failed request:  BadMatch (invalid parameter attributes)
  Major opcode of failed request:  42 (X_SetInputFocus)
  Serial number of failed request:  80
  Current serial number in output stream:  89
```

Reverting to SFML 2.2 at this point would be especially painful owing to the recent GCC C++ ABI change.
By the way, a workaround is to recompile SFML 2.2 using the Arch ABS. Simply modify the latest sfml package's PKGBUILD pkgver variable from 2.3 to 2.2. The bug is absent in 2.2.
Same on Arch Linux with xmonad-0.12.

issue.title: sf::Window.create() fails on non-reparenting linux WMs
issue.body:
I'm working on rewriting one of my projects in SFML2 and have run into the following issue.  When I create a sf::RenderWindow as follows I get an immediate crash:

``` c++
win.create(sf::VideoMode::getDesktopMode(), "Title");
```

When I try to run the program I get the following error output:

```
X Error of failed request:  BadMatch (invalid parameter attributes)
  Major opcode of failed request:  42 (X_SetInputFocus)
  Serial number of failed request:  96
  Current serial number in output stream:  105
```

I've done a fair bit of experiementing and initially thought it was my WM (a very simple nonreparenting WM).  The WM was not making any calls to XSetInputFoucs, so the source of that Xlib call must be within SFML.  I've found I get the exact same error on other nonreparenting WMs including DWM, while it works as expected on reparenting WMs.

As a workaround I've found the following code works, but is not ideal as the Fullscreen window is completely unmaged by the WM:

``` c++
if (getenv("NON_REPARENTING"))
   win.create(sf::VideoMode::getDesktopMode(), "Title", sf::Style::Fullscreen);
else
   win.create(sf::VideoMode::getDesktopMode(), "Title");
```

With this code, it works as long as NON_REPARENTING is set in the environment for nonreparenting WMs.

I've confirmed the same error (and workaround) with the simple example program provided here:
http://www.sfml-dev.org/tutorials/2.3/start-linux.php

I think by now it is kind of obvious that many people are able to reproduce the issue. At this stage, it would help more to test the proposed fix.
